python.note: Pure-Python FIPS 204 / FIPS 203 implementations. pycryptodome is required by kyber-py's seeded DRBG; without it kyber-py warns on stdout. Version pins are checked at run time; update them here deliberately, not silently.

liboqs.note: The reference C implementation, built from source in a container because liboqs needs a C toolchain. liboqs and its Python binding are version-locked to each other; a mismatch makes the binding clone a liboqs branch that does not exist. Rebuild with: docker build -f peers/liboqs.Dockerfile -t kxco-interop-liboqs:0.16.0 peers/

openssl.note: Issues the X.509 certificates and CMS SignedData blobs that conformance/protocol verifies. OpenSSL 3.5 is the first line carrying ML-DSA, and the Dockerfile asserts that at build time rather than assuming it. Rebuild with: docker build -f conformance/protocol/openssl.Dockerfile -t kxco-protocol-openssl:3.5 conformance/protocol
